HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects the key financial and factual terms present in the source document. All specific claims are supported:

- Date of agreement (May 13, 2021) ✓
- Borrower name (SESI, L.L.C., Delaware LLC) ✓
- Parent company (SESI Holdings, Inc., Delaware corporation) ✓
- Administrative Agent (JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.) ✓
- Participating lenders (Bank of America, N.A. and Citibank, N.A.) ✓
- Original credit agreement date (February 2, 2021) ✓
- Extension deadline (June 1, 2021) ✓
- Specific covenant sections referenced (4.2(a)(ii) and 6.7(a)) ✓
- All subsidiary guarantor names listed ✓
- Q1 2021 financial reporting issues ✓
- Form 10-Q filing concerns ✓

The memo appropriately uses "N/A" for deal terms not disclosed in the amendment document (interest rates, loan amounts, maturity, etc.) rather than fabricating information. The background information about the energy services sector is reasonably inferred from the subsidiary names without making unsupported factual claims about specific financial metrics.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all key financial terms available in the source document. The source document is an amendment to an existing credit agreement, and amendment documents typically do not restate the original deal terms (interest rates, loan amounts, maturity dates, etc.) - they only address the specific modifications being made. 

The memo correctly identifies and includes all material terms present in the source document:
- Transaction parties (borrower, guarantors, administrative agent, lenders)
- Amendment date (May 13, 2021)
- Original credit agreement date (February 2, 2021) 
- Specific covenant sections being waived (4.2(a)(ii) and 6.7(a))
- Financial reporting extension deadline (June 1, 2021)
- Conditions precedent requirements

The memo also appropriately notes in the Key Deal Terms Table that this is an amendment document and that "Original deal terms are not disclosed in this amendment document," which accurately reflects the limitations of the source material.
